decision.reason: [ev-d21916050360] is a compatibility assurance, not a description of a change. It lists three kinds of resource together (legacy cluster-scoped XRs with claims, legacy cluster-scoped MRs and existing Compositions) and says only that they "continue working" under an internal `LegacyCluster` scope. It names no single field, API or behaviour that differs between v1 and v2, so no before/after or replacedBy value can be stated. Without a concrete subject and change, no applicability condition can be written. The excerpt is also cut off before the example claim, so evidence that names the actual change (for example, how `LegacyCluster` scope is assigned or exposed) is still missing.
